pages.title: Privacy policy · PrecisionFix
pages.description: How PrecisionFix handles your information: no tracking, no ads, no selling. What the booking form collects and who helps run the site.

findings.title: every sitemap URL is a live, indexable, canonical page
findings.message: the sitemap lists 2 URL(s) on another host: https://precisionfixmobile.com/, https://precisionfixmobile.com/privacy/

findings.title: every linked page answers 200
findings.message: http://localhost:8899/account/ answers 404
findings.fix: Restore the page or remove the links to it.

findings.title: every image loads
findings.message: 5 image(s) do not load: /.netlify/images?url=%2Fimg%2Fphotos%2Fporsche-911-gt3-rs.j… → 404, /.netlify/images?url=%2Fimg%2Fphotos%2Fengine-rebuild.jpg&w… → 404, /.netlify/images?url=%2Fimg%2Fphotos%2Fmercedes-amg-sl63.jp… → 404 (+2 more)
findings.fix: Fix the path or re-upload the photo.

findings.title: no internal link is broken
findings.message: 1 broken internal link(s): http://localhost:8899/account/ → 404
findings.fix: Fix the address or remove the link.

findings.title: http:// sends visitors to https://
findings.message: the site is served over plain http://
findings.fix: Serve it over HTTPS; Netlify provisions the certificate once the domain points at the site.

findings.title: the canonical points at this page (or a live one)
findings.message: the canonical points at https://precisionfixmobile.com/privacy/, which answers 404
findings.fix: A canonical must name a page that answers 200 directly.

findings.title: robots.txt answers
findings.message: /robots.txt answers with an HTML page instead of a robots file
findings.fix: Serve a plain-text robots.txt, or a real 404.

findings.title: the canonical points at this page (or a live one)
findings.message: the canonical hands this page's ranking to another site: https://precisionfixmobile.com/
findings.fix: Right when this copy is the secondary one; wrong if this is the address people should find.

findings.title: the first big image loads with priority
findings.message: the first large image is lazy-loaded (/.netlify/images?url=%2Fimg%2Fphotos%2Fporsche-91…): the browser waits to fetch what is probably the largest thing on screen
findings.fix: Remove loading="lazy" from the hero image and add fetchpriority="high".

findings.title: the page is served compressed
findings.message: the HTML is served without gzip or brotli compression
findings.fix: Turn on compression at the host (Netlify does it by default).

findings.title: the page has a link preview (Open Graph)
findings.message: no Open Graph tags: a link to this page in a text or on Facebook shows no title card or photo
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description, og:image (1200×630), og:url and og:type.

findings.title: structured data points at this site
findings.message: structured data names another host (url: https://precisionfixmobile.com/, @id: https://precisionfixmobile.com/#website, url: https://precisionfixmobile.com/, @id: https://prec…)
findings.fix: url and @id must use this site's own address.

findings.title: AI search crawlers are not shut out by accident
findings.message: no AI-crawler rules in robots.txt: every crawler is allowed by the default group

findings.title: a second language is reachable by search engines
findings.message: Spanish copy is swapped in by the browser on the same URL (data-es): search engines index the English page only
findings.fix: This serves Spanish-speaking visitors who arrive, not Spanish searches. To rank in Spanish, add a real /es page with its own title and hreflang tags.

findings.title: the page says where the business works
findings.message: the page mentions "Menu Austin, TX", but no city or service area is on file for this business
findings.fix: Confirm the service area with the owner and record it, so the title and structured data can use it.

findings.title: the site connects to the business's profiles
findings.message: no link to a Google Business Profile or a review page
findings.fix: Once the Business Profile is verified, link to it (and to its "leave a review" link) from the site.

findings.title: PageSpeed Insights scores
findings.message: PageSpeed (mobile) did not return a result: PageSpeed API 429: Quota exceeded for quota metric 'Queries' and limit 'Queries per day' of service 'pagespeedonline.googleapis.com' for co; no Chrome for local Lighthouse (set CHROME_PATH)

findings.title: PageSpeed Insights scores
findings.message: PageSpeed (desktop) did not return a result: PageSpeed API 429: Quota exceeded for quota metric 'Queries' and limit 'Queries per day' of service 'pagespeedonline.googleapis.com' for co; no Chrome for local Lighthouse (set CHROME_PATH)

findings.title: baseline security headers are present
findings.message: missing response header(s): Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options
findings.fix: Add them at the host (netlify.toml [[headers]]). Not a ranking factor; it is basic hygiene.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: AutoRepair at @graph[1]: no "sameAs" links (Business Profile, Instagram, Facebook). Add them once the profiles exist
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: other structured data types are well formed
findings.message: FAQPage: Google shows FAQ rich results only for well-known government and health sites; the markup is harmless and still helps other engines read the answers
